feeds.title: City of Carmel
feeds.description: Carmel is one of the fastest-growing cities in Indiana. Located just north of Indianapolis in Hamilton County, Carmel is a dynamic edge city with award-winning schools, thriving businesses, and family-oriented neighborhoods. Follow this feed for the latest news, city updates, traffic alerts, economic, environment development, election news, and much more.
